sentence: This project studies non-standard proteins that cells make, called the dark proteome, and how they work in cancer.
This project studies how alternative splicing differs between cell types in the brain of people with and without autism spectrum disorder.
This project tries to find out how the centrosome-cilium complex, found in almost all human cell types, is built and regulated.
This project builds an injectable, biodegradable method to form 3D spheroids that support stem cell therapy for repair after injury.
This project studies how e-cigarette retailer access and tobacco regulations relate to e-cigarette use and marketing exposure among youth.
This project looks for lead compounds that could treat non-alcoholic fatty liver disease by targeting pathways of energy homeostasis and nutrient metabolism.
This project studies how age-related tauopathies add to late life cognitive decline and to Alzheimer's Disease.
This project studies how a microRNA and its distal enhancer control genetic networks in the developing retina in a knockout mouse model.
This project runs a national coordinating center that brings together genomic and demographic data on marmosets and gives scientists access to the animals.
This project builds a genome browser that brings together many sources of information to help understand the function of genes in the human genome.
This project studies how the bacteria that cause gonorrhea harm tissue and how they make cell wall fragments that trigger the immune response.
This project builds a test that uses CRISPR to show which drugs work against tuberculosis and can be used outside centralized labs.
This project uses artificial intelligence to build a model that estimates interstitial fibrosis from a kidney ultrasonography image.
This project gets a sequencing system that many research groups will use for basic, translational and clinical research.
This project studies how serotonin acts on cells and synapses in the auditory cortex and changes its network activity.
This project supports a research center that works to understand the causes of diseases of the digestive tract and liver and to develop treatments.
This project builds tools for interactive online viewing and analysis of very large multi-omics single-cell and bulk tumor data.
This project uses machine learning to test whether bacteria enzymes and microbial metabolites relate to mycophenolic acid exposure in kidney transplant recipients.
This project works to reduce the cancer burden in non-metropolitan areas where people have limited access to healthcare.
This project studies the heart problems that can follow cancer immunotherapy and ischemic injury, which currently lack specific treatments.
